name: Backgammon: Fair Dice
tag: A good game. A fair roll.
description: Backgammon and long nardy with a worthy opponent, beautiful boards, and dice you can verify yourself.
headline:
Enjoy the game.
Trust the dice.
story_title: The proof is part of the game.
story: Every dice sequence is sealed before the first move. When the game ends, the key is revealed. Check the rolls yourself, right here on the website.
features: An opponent you can grow with
Five levels, hints on the board, and a coach that explains mistakes. Review the moments that changed your game.
Find your favorite board
Wood, stone, leather, and regional designs. Make a familiar game feel like your own.
Play your way
Backgammon or long nardy. Play against the computer, or share your phone with a friend.
pricing: Both games are free to play. Optional Pro removes ads and the hint limit. Additional boards are sold separately.
privacy: Games stay on your iPhone, with an optional copy in your own iCloud. The free version has ads between games; Pro removes them.

name: Pilot Logbook
description: Your flights, totals, and currency in one clear logbook. Built for US pilots, ready when there is no signal.
headline:
More time flying.
Less time counting.
story_title: A clear picture of your flying.
story: Keep flight totals, recent experience, and important dates together. See what is current and what is coming up, without recounting your logbook.
features: Minutes that add up
Time is stored in whole minutes. Three flights of 40 minutes add up to exactly two hours.
Bring your history
Import from ForeFlight, LogTen, or MyFlightbook. Preview changes before they are written, and export your book to CSV or PDF.
Ready for the paperwork
The Record of Pilot Time grid for FAA Form 8710-1, filled from your flights. Instructor signatures and progress toward ratings, in the same book.
pricing: Your first 25 manually entered flights are free; imports do not count toward the limit. Unlimited flights: $24.99/year or $59.99 once. US prices; local App Store prices may vary.
privacy: No account, analytics, or advertising. Your book lives on your device, with an optional iCloud Drive backup in the full version.
note: You are responsible for your logbook and compliance with applicable regulations. The app does not replace your own checks or your instructor. Not affiliated with the FAA.

name: Cycle Ally
description: A calm PCOS and PMOS journal that helps you bring your history to your next appointment.
headline:
Your health,
in your own words.

name: MGRS Land Nav
tag: Find your way. Build your skills.
description: Clear coordinates and practical training for pace count, azimuth, and plotting.
headline:
Know where you are.
Learn where to go.
story_title: Practice before the phone goes away.
story: Calibrate your pace count, walk a blind leg, and review where you drifted. Turn a position on a screen into a skill you can use in the field.
features: Your grid, at a glance
Large 8- or 10-digit MGRS coordinates, alongside UTM, latitude and longitude, and the grid-to-magnetic angle.
Plan the next leg
Save points, project an azimuth and distance, and plan courses with pace counts. Import and export GPX.
Train your map skills
Practice plotting an 8-digit grid and review your blind-leg sessions. Learn from the route you actually walked.
pricing: Position and coordinate conversion are free. Training tools are available with a one-time Pro purchase.
privacy: No account, advertising, or tracking. Location is used for navigation on your device.
note: A training aid. Phones are not allowed on graded land navigation courses; practice with it beforehand.

name: Solunar Times: Hunt & Fish
description: Sun, moon, and solunar periods for your next trip. Calculated on your iPhone, even off the grid.
headline:
A little planning.
More time outside.
story_title: The day ahead, at a glance.
story: See major and minor periods alongside sunrise, sunset, and moon times. Plan for your place and date, then leave the signal behind.
features: Know why a day scores well
A day score with its reasons shown. A guide to planning your trip, never a promise of a catch.
Keep your own evidence
Log bites, catches, and sightings. See whether your own observations fall inside the suggested periods.
Stay in the moment
Widgets, Live Activity, and alerts before major periods. Your phone does the calculations, without a connection.
pricing: Today and tomorrow at your current location are free. Pro is a one-time purchase, with no subscription.
privacy: No ads, account, or tracking. Times are computed on your iPhone.

name: Bowling Score Keeper
tag: There is a better game in you.
description: Keep the score. Find the spares that cost you points. Understand how your game is changing.
headline:
Every frame tells
a better story.
story: Track your average over time and see which leaves you convert. Find the patterns worth working on next time you step up to the lane.
features: A quick game or a full session
Enter every frame or just the final score. Keep as many games in a session as you played.
Know your spares
Separate single-pin leaves, multi-pin leaves, and splits. See the conversions behind your average.
Build your own record
Track your arsenal and average by ball. Correct any entry, import CSV, and export your history.
pricing: Game entry and your full history are free. Detailed statistics, filters, and export are available with a paid upgrade.
privacy: No account, advertising, or trackers. Your record stays on your device.
